title: Old Fashioned Oven Roasted Dutch Endive Gratin
description: A traditional Dutch dish featuring roasted endive, this gratin is a bitter, fluffy, and romantic delight, with the brightness of lime juice and the earthiness of terracotta cooking.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large terracotta dish, arrange the endive halves in a single layer, cut side up.
Dot the top of each endive half with unsalted butter.
Drizzle the lime juice over the endive, then sprinkle with minced garlic.
Season with salt, black pepper, and chopped fresh thyme.
Sprinkle the shredded gruyere cheese evenly over the top of the endive.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and roast for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue roasting for an additional 20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the endive is tender.
